title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta27

Beta27 narrows Notification discovery to the main Navimow app feed instead of guessing more endpoints.

- Keeps the beta26 Notification sensor and exact read-only `get-vehicle-history-message` probe unchanged.
- Adds a bounded public-H5 scanner only to Home Assistant **Download diagnostics**.
- Targets exact UI strings observed in the app: `All`, `Important`, `Work status`, `System`, `Device`, `newMessages`, `No more messages`, and `Failed to load new messages`.
- For matching source context, records nearby `/mowerbot/...` route literals, HTTP method hints, and `sendEncryptionData` / `callNative` / `sendMessageToNative` bridge calls.
- Follows only a bounded number of JavaScript assets and dynamic chunks that occur near those UI strings.
- Does not send Navimow credentials, mower serials, account ids, device ids, or p:101 payloads to the public H5 host and never stores full HTML/JavaScript source bodies.
- `navimower.export_diagnostics`, normal polling, mower controls, and notification read state are unchanged.
